passages.exact_text_after_whitespace_normalizatio: The date of this prospectus supplement is October 26, 2026.
We currently do not have any shares of preferred stock outstanding.

agreed to issue and sell 250,000,000 Series A depositary shares (the “Depositary Shares”), each representing a 1/20th interest in a share of 6.50% Series A Mandatory Convertible Preferred Stock, liquidation preference $1,000.00 per share
The Depositary Shares Offering closed on October 29, 2026.

On October 29, 2026, the underwriters of our previously completed offering of Series A depositary shares exercised in full their over-allotment option to purchase an additional 37,500,000 Series A depositary shares (the “Additional Depositary Shares”), each representing a 1/20th interest in a share of the Company’s 6.50% Series A Mandatory Convertible Preferred Stock, liquidation preference $1,000 per share, par value $0.000006 per share. The Company issued the Additional Depositary Shares on November 2, 2026

meta_preferred_issuance.scope: Stated liquidation preference from disclosed issuances, before dividend and conversion effects; not market value, net proceeds or a current outstanding balance certification.
meta_preferred_issuance.historical_zero_boundary: The prospectus dated October 26, 2026 expressly reports no then-outstanding preferred stock. This does not establish the December 31, 2023, 2024 or 2025 balances.

original_source_evidence.alphabet_boundary: Three- and nine-month amounts do not establish complete 2023, 2024 or 2025 annual amortization. No annualization or balance-difference inference; no extra finance-lease amortization added to PP&E depreciation.
